scope: Specific observed source issues and preservation decisions, not an exhaustive historical fact check.

issues.evidence: Both official current and files-route HTML have id Page_041 but visible text 411.

issues.evidence: Both official HTML files omit these two numeric anchors. HTML transcriber notice says blank page numbers were not reproduced; that does not establish that both these particular pages were blank.
issues.action: Do not invent markers or omitted text. Page spans after Page_186 remain source-anchor contexts and do not assert printed page identity for text where the marker is absent.
